checks.question: Partial shipment and return preserve remaining inventory
checks.sql: SELECT f.quantity,r.quantity,l.quantity-f.quantity+r.quantity FROM order_lines l JOIN fulfillments f ON f.line_id=l.id JOIN returns r ON r.line_id=l.id WHERE f.quantity<l.quantity

checks.question: Find over-fulfilled lines without repairing source quantities
checks.sql: SELECT f.id FROM fulfillments f JOIN order_lines l ON f.line_id=l.id WHERE f.quantity>l.quantity ORDER BY f.id

checks.question: Compare exact payment, invoice and refund amounts
checks.sql: SELECT p.id FROM payments p JOIN invoices i ON p.invoice_id=i.id WHERE p.amount=i.amount AND p.currency=i.currency

checks.question: Return and refund use the original product price
checks.sql: SELECT r.id FROM refunds r JOIN returns x ON x.id=r.return_id JOIN order_lines l ON l.id=x.line_id JOIN products p ON p.id=l.product_id WHERE r.amount=x.quantity*p.unit_price

checks.question: A split lot reaches two shipments and exposes temperature excursion
checks.sql: SELECT l.lot_code,COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) FROM lots l JOIN items i ON i.lot_id=l.id JOIN shipment_items x ON x.item_id=i.id JOIN shipments s ON s.id=x.shipment_id GROUP BY l.lot_code

checks.question: Compare temperature against explicit upper limit

checks.question: Expose duplicate upstream event identity

checks.question: Trace serialized item through lot and nested container

checks.question: Keep method and temperature unit with measurements

checks.question: Trace finding to account and failure evidence

checks.question: Event-to-incident link is attributable data

checks.question: Temperature alarm precedes maintenance and resumed run

checks.question: Do not concatenate unlabeled sensor units

checks.question: Trace run through work order and material lot

checks.question: Replacement identifies the actual component

checks.question: Find unbalanced journals without rounding into balance

checks.question: A status event is distinct from settlement evidence

checks.question: The valid result stays attached to the right offering

checks.question: Delayed post-midnight arrival retains original service date

checks.question: Brokerage, listing media and unit maintenance retain actual identities

checks.question: Withdrawn listing has no inferred sale

checks.question: Parcel, property, building and unit retain distinct identities

checks.question: Valuation does not become transaction price

checks.question: Cumulative reading kind and energy unit remain explicit
